A '''city-ship''' was a large vessel that served a dual purpose as a habitat.

==History==
The first city-ships were built on [[Ska Gora]] in [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was colonized, which was where practically all planet's population lived.<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref><ref name="DOTJ:ITV">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>

Great orbital city-ships were constructed by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] to provide an alternative to the polluted surface of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Many great [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] came from these Duros-made vessels.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> They were attacked during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Duro as part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]].<ref name="CISSD15:2:29">{{InsiderCite|74|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:2:29 Edition}}</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used the captured [[Jyvus Space City]] as his command post while launching his groundside offensive.<ref name="RHNNCE15:3:02">{{InsiderCite|75|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02}}</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces that [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|invaded]] Duro brought down several of these city-ships onto the surface, while one managed to escape into deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] using its [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight thrusters]].<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>

An aquatic city-ship was the [[Great Ship]] of [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]], constructed by survivors of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew that crash-landed on the water planet.<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (1977) 13|''Star Wars'' (1977) 13]]</ref>
